summary: Ericsson filed a Form 6-K announcing weekly repurchases of own Class B shares under its buyback program. During September 21-25, 2026, it repurchased 500,000 Class B shares at a weighted average of SEK 96.5615 for total consideration SEK 48,280,770, executed on Nasdaq Stockholm by Goldman Sachs Bank Europe SE under the EU MAR safe harbour. The program, announced April 16, 2026, totals up to SEK 15,000,000,000 and runs through March 31, 2027. Treasury stock now stands at 108,518,663 Class B shares. Watch pace and cancellation proposal at the 2027 AGM.
